description: A real RFC 3161 token from a probe TSA (certificate shipped beside it): status granted and the TSTInfo messageImprint equals the digest, so 'verified' is true — that is BINDING (SPEC §3.2). TSA authenticity is a separate field: the reference proves it with --tsa-cert (openssl ts -verify, chain checked at the token's genTime); the JS verifier reports tsa_verified null and does not pass --require-anchor --tsa-cert (declared divergence).
